scope: CPU-only re-analysis of immutable R0.4/R0.6 score receipts and R0.7 evaluated rows, plus optional N2 CLIP zero-shot baseline (<=0.25 GPU-h)
forbidden: B24 confirmation305 access of any kind

inputs.score_receipts: R0.4 and R0.6 per-candidate JSON records as enumerated by the R0.7 preparation audit (field prior.draw_losses holds 32 losses per orbit member in (t, j) order: t index = k // 4, j = k % 4)

cohorts.B22_random: image_ids of the B22 final100 panel (S1); includes S3/S4 runs (their 8 ids are B22 ids) and S5 runs on B22 ids
cohorts.DEV80_enriched: image_ids of B24 DEV80 (S2); includes S5 runs on DEV80 ids
cohorts.overlap_check: assert the two id sets are disjoint; STOP if not

n1d_cost_accuracy.decision: argmin over the member set of the mean loss over the selected (t, j); if loss(000) - min <= 1e-7 choose 000

metrics.success: fraction of ORBIT_ERROR candidates whose chosen member has PSNR >= 25
metrics.harm: fraction of GOOD candidates whose chosen member has PSNR < 25
metrics.exact: fraction of ORBIT_ERROR candidates with chosen member == s_gt

n1d_cost_accuracy.orbit_psnr_source: use stored eight-member PSNRs if present in R0.7 rows; otherwise recompute offline on CPU with the R0.7 GT catalog via orbit_psnr_channel_mse (analysis-only GT access)
n1d_cost_accuracy.selection_rule: on dev only: among configurations with dev success >= 0.95 and dev harm == 0, choose minimum unet_forwards; tie-break: member set all8 before global2, then larger J, then T subset order all8, mid4, single 50..700
n1d_cost_accuracy.report: full grid on both splits (EXPLORATORY), and the selected configuration's eval success/harm with image-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 replicates, seed rule R0BOOT|r0n_cost_eval)
n1d_cost_accuracy.paired_variance: per candidate and t: r_t = Var_j(l_000 - l_111) / (Var_j(l_000) + Var_j(l_111)) using ddof=1 over the 4 draws; report median and IQR of r_t over candidates per t and pooled, separately for GOOD and ORBIT_ERROR candidates

n2_clip_zero_shot.model: /egr/research-pac/huang248/models/clip/ViT-L-14.pt (SHA-256 b8cca3fd41ae0c99ba7e8951adf17d267cdb84cd88be6f7c2e0eca1737a03836) loaded with the UnivFD repository's models/clip module (BPE vocab bundled there)
n2_clip_zero_shot.image_preprocess: canonical RGB8 candidate -> PIL -> CLIP standard preprocess from clip.load (Resize 224 bicubic, CenterCrop 224, CLIP mean/std)
prompts_upright: a photo of a person's face.
a portrait photo of a person.
prompts_inverted: an upside-down photo of a face.
an upside-down photo of a person's face.
an upside-down portrait photo of a person.
n2_clip_zero_shot.text_embedding: L2-normalize each prompt embedding, average per class, re-normalize
n2_clip_zero_shot.score: u(x) = <f(x), t_up> - <f(x), t_inv>, f(x) the L2-normalized image embedding
n2_clip_zero_shot.decision_global: choose 111 iff u(R_111 x) > u(x) strictly; else 000

comparators_global_only.prior: choose 111 iff S['111'] < S['000'] - 1e-7 (stored frozen S)

n2_clip_zero_shot.metrics: success on GLOBAL orbit errors (s_gt == 111), harm on GOOD, and count of partial orbit errors left unfixed

bounded_checks: FAST-DIPS checkout: grep for imagenet256 in its model loader config (no download)
n3_imagenet_inventory.rule: record presence/absence and file sizes only; no download, no enumeration of image trees
